question: What should someone watch for in the next twelve months?

beats.line: Diginex has faced significant headwinds. The stock collapsed to one dollar sixteen.
beats.action: A halftone stack of paper coins drops onto a cream chip, topples half its height and holds.
beats.delivery: [presenting to camera] Diginex has faced significant headwinds. The stock collapsed to one dollar sixteen.

beats.line: Cash runway tightened to roughly one point four months at operating burn rates.
beats.headline: 1.4 MONTHS
beats.action: The previous chip slides off the top edge as the coin stack unrolls into a torn runway that stops short; a black paper ribbon runs from the coin stack to the torn runway, and a coin-sized cream tag reading '1.4 months' sits beside the ribbon, a short black line pointing at it.
beats.delivery: Cash runway tightened to roughly one point four months at operating burn rates.

beats.line: Management promised further updates on its unified business strategy over the second quarter of twenty twenty-six.
beats.headline: Q2 2026
beats.action: The previous chip flips away as the torn runway folds up into a small pile of stacked sheets alone on open ground.
beats.delivery: Management promised further updates on its unified business strategy over the second quarter of twenty twenty-six.

beats.line: Watch whether the four acquired businesses are operationally unified, not siloed. Cross-sell traction is the test.
beats.headline: UNIFIED OR SILOED
beats.action: The previous chip is covered as the stacked sheets fan into four separate sheets; a paper hand presses them back together, and an orange paper arrow now runs from the stacked sheets to a paper calendar page.
beats.delivery: [fast-paced] Watch whether the four acquired businesses are operationally unified, not siloed. Cross-sell traction is the test.

beats.line: Also watch revenue run-rate progress toward the two hundred and eighty million dollar group revenue target by twenty twenty-seven.
beats.headline: $280M BY 2027
beats.action: The previous chip slides off as the stacked sheets rise into a paper bar chart that fills the frame, its tallest bar locking upright; the orange arrow stays in place beneath it.
beats.delivery: Also watch revenue run-rate progress toward the two hundred and eighty million dollar group revenue target by twenty twenty-seven.

beats.line: The one point five billion dollar Resulticks acquisition is the transformative bet.
beats.headline: $1.5B
beats.action: The previous chip flips down as the paper bar chart collapses sideways into one large paper document resting alone on open ground.
beats.delivery: The one point five billion dollar Resulticks acquisition is the transformative bet.

beats.line: Without cross-sell evidence by the third or fourth quarter of twenty twenty-six, it becomes a financial burden.
beats.headline: Q3–Q4 2026
beats.action: The previous chip slides off as a corner of the large paper document tears into a paper calendar page; a red paper string runs from the document to that page and pulls taut.
beats.delivery: Without cross-sell evidence by the third or fourth quarter of twenty twenty-six, it becomes a financial burden.

beats.line: Cash stood at one point eight five million, with operating burn near one point three million a month.
beats.headline: $1.85M CASH
beats.action: The previous chip is covered as the large paper document swells to fill the frame and paper coins slide off its lower edge one by one; a coin-sized cream tag reading '$1.3M' sits beside the red string, a short black line pointing at it.
beats.delivery: Cash stood at one point eight five million, with operating burn near one point three million a month.

beats.line: Diginex needs credible evidence of platform traction by the fourth quarter of twenty twenty-six.
beats.headline: Q4 2026
beats.action: The previous chip flips away as the loose paper coins gather back into the coin stack; two paper calendar pages land beside it and a cream paper ribbon runs from the coin stack to those pages.
beats.delivery: Diginex needs credible evidence of platform traction by the fourth quarter of twenty twenty-six.

beats.line: The next six to nine months are make-or-break for the investment case.
beats.headline: 6–9 MONTHS
beats.action: The previous chip slides off as the coin stack stands alone again; a paper hand presses a strip of tape across its middle and holds it there, the cream ribbon still in place.
beats.delivery: The next six to nine months are make-or-break for the investment case.
